issues.description: The UML in the problem statement declares numberOfInscribedStudents and numberOfGuestStudents as double (fractional) types, but the solution implements these attributes as int. This mismatch between the specification (UML) and the reference implementation can confuse students about the correct data type to use for student counts and may lead to inconsistent implementations or failing tests.
issues.suggestedFix: Make the types consistent across artifacts. Preferably, change the UML in problem_statement.md to declare numberOfInscribedStudents and numberOfGuestStudents as int (whole numbers), since student counts are naturally integers. Alternatively, if fractional values are intended, update the solution and template to use double for these attributes and adjust related methods (constructor, getters/setters, total/calculation methods) accordingly.
